title: pvGeometryFilter
body:
## pvGeometryFilter

ParaView's rendering geometry extractor (vtkPVGeometryFilter): converts any dataset, including composite and nonlinear-cell data, into polydata of its outer surface or, with UseOutline, its bounding outline, adding original cell and point id arrays by default. Representations use it internally; as a pipeline node it is a robust way to get the renderable surface. For an ordinary surface use surface or pvExtractSurface.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Interior faces are not produced; slice or clip first to see inside a volume.
- Higher NonlinearSubdivisionLevel values multiply the polygon count exponentially.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `GeometryFilter`. Identity: `filters/GeometryFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the input to the Geometry Filter. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":[],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NonlinearSubdivisionLevel` | Nonlinear faces are approximated with flat polygons. This parameter controls how many times to subdivide nonlinear surface cells. Higher subdivisions generate closer approximations but take more memory and rendering time. Subdivision is recursive, so the number of output polygons can grow exponentially with this parameter. | `{"maximum":4,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `PassThroughIds` | If on, the output polygonal dataset will have a cell data array that holds the cell index of the original 3D cell that produced each output cell. This is useful for cell picking. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PassThroughPointIds` | If on, the output polygonal dataset will have a point data array that holds the point index of the original 3D vertex that produced each output vertex. This is useful for picking. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UseOutline` | Toggle whether to generate an outline or a surface. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvGeometryFilter",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
